name: Sidebar & Copyright Manager for Storefront by Wp-Centrics
author: wp-centrics

sections.description:
Take full control of the Storefront theme sidebar and footer copyright — no code required.

This plugin lets you manage Storefront sidebar visibility and customize the footer copyright area using native WordPress controls.

🚀 Key Benefits

✔ Manage Storefront sidebar visibility for each page type
✔ Improve WooCommerce conversions with cleaner layouts
✔ Create distraction-free, full-width pages
✔ Hide or Replace Storefront footer copyright with widgets
✔ Strengthen brand identity in your Storefront footer
✔ No code required — fully integrated with WordPress Customizer

🛒 Create Distraction-Free Pages in Storefront

Decide exactly where the Storefront sidebar should appear — and remove it where it hurts conversions.

WordPress Pages

  • Front page
  • Blog page
  • Single posts
  • Pages
  • Post categories
  • Post tags
  • Search results

WooCommerce Pages

  • Shop page
  • Product categories
  • Product tags
  • Single products
  • Cart page
  • Checkout page
  • My Account page
  • Order received page

Perfect for improving checkout focus, simplifying product pages, and increasing WooCommerce conversions with cleaner layouts.

🎨 Storefront Footer Copyright Customization

Easily customize the Storefront footer copyright section.

  • Hide the default Storefront copyright text
  • Replace it with one full-width widget area
  • Or create two footer widget columns
  • Add logo, business address, extra navigation menu or custom HTML

The plugin replaces only the bottom copyright section and remains fully compatible with Storefront’s upper footer widget areas.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Appearance > Storefront Tweaks to configure the settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with other themes or plugins?

Full compatibility is guaranteed with the Storefront theme.

If your theme uses the standard WordPress sidebar ID “sidebar-1”, the sidebar visibility controls will likely work as well.

However, the footer copyright replacement is specifically built for Storefront and will not work with other themes.

Will it affect my existing footer widgets?

No. The plugin does not modify Storefront’s upper footer widget areas.

As an option, it can replace the default copyright section with one or two additional widget areas:

  • One full-width column
  • Or two columns (left and right)

You can use these areas to add logo, text, menus, address or any other widget content.

Do I need coding knowledge?

No. Everything is managed through standard WordPress controls.
